nom: BIODERMA Sensibio H2O Mizellen-Reinigung, 500 ml Solution

avis.titre: An effective and kind to my sensitive, dry skin.
avis.texte: Works well on my sensitive dry skin. Won’t take off makeup completely, but works well as an evening cleanse before bed if I haven’t been wearing foundation. I do need to use a separate cleanser to completely remove mascara but I think that is to be expected. It will work if I allow the product to sit on the lashes with a cotton pad however. A separate remover is just faster when I am tired. No adverse effects on the skin and it doesn’t dry sticky or feel like I need to separately cleanse the cleanser lol. A good product. I will repurchase.

I've tried a lot of micellar water brands and this is by far my favourite. I don't usually have sensitive skin but found that the previous brand i was using made my skin sting any time I used it after I'd used my glycolic acid wash- as soon as I swapped to this Bioderma one, no more stinging at all and it still removed all my everyday make up perfectly without drying out my skin. The only thing to note is that if you wear heavy duty waterproof mascara, this doesn't remove all of it for me, I personally still have to cleanse my lashes with an oilier based product but this micellar water does loosen it and remove 60-70%- For context, 1) it doesn't remove Lancome Lash Idole Waterproof Mascara but does loosen it, 2) it does remove most of Estee Lauder Sumptuous Extreme Waterproof Mascara.
